text.p: Severe weather with wind damage, flooding rains, hail, and tornadoes raked much of eastern Texas, Arkansas, parts of northern Mississippi and also portions of Tennessee, Kentucky, West Virginia, and southern Ohio on the weekend. The hardest-hit area in terms of tornadoes was Arkansas. Conditions will improve today and will be more tranquil through Tuesday as cleanup continues.

Heavy rain, flooding, and mudslides occurred over central Mozambique as Tropical Cyclone Lisette made landfall late Sunday. Lisette is now dissipating and rain squalls will come to an end during the next 12 hours.
Tropical Cyclone 31P northeast of New Hebrides is expected to intensify over the next 24-48 hours but poses no threat to land at this time.
